info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Corporate Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Finance Update API allows for the modification of specific corporate finance records based on a unique parameter identifier. This endpoint supports updates to various aspects of public offering data, ensuring that users can keep their financial information current. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, corporate finance teams, and data analysts looking to manage public offering details efficiently. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance their reporting and compliance capabilities with timely and accurate data adjustments.
